# lumos_task (Data Source)

Task DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lumos_task" "my_task" {
  expand = [
    "..."
  ]
  task_id = "...my_task_id..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `task_id` (String) The ID of the task.

### Optional

- `expand` (List of String) Fields to expand: actions, assignees, comments.
